summary: Iteration 4: validated the NEW auth flow (NO admin_code field), notifications, jitsi video/audio calls, interview join, admin messages call buttons, overview widgets, and dark toggle. Backend: 24/24 pytest passing (test file updated to drop admin_code requirement and added notifications regression). Frontend: all critical flows PASS after fixing 2 blocking bugs (missing Video/Phone/VideoCall imports in ChatWidget.js and AdminDashboard.js, plus missing `useState` for `call` inside the Interviews sub-component of AdminDashboard.js). Without these fixes the app crashed with `ReferenceError: Video is not defined` when opening the candidate ChatWidget, and the admin Interviews page would throw when rendered.
action_items: None blocking — all fixes have already been applied by the testing agent (see updated_files). Main agent should be aware that previously ChatWidget.js and AdminDashboard.js referenced Video, Phone, VideoCall without importing them, and Interviews() in AdminDashboard.js referenced call/setCall without declaring the useState. This should not regress; keep it in the checklist for future feature additions.
critical_code_review_comments: ChatWidget.js was missing imports for `Video`, `Phone` (lucide-react) and `VideoCall` component even though they were used in JSX. Blocked entire ChatWidget render with a runtime ReferenceError. Fixed.

AdminDashboard.js was missing `Video`, `Phone` (lucide-react) and `VideoCall` imports; Interviews() sub-component also referenced `call` / `setCall` without declaring `const [call, setCall] = useState(null)`. Fixed.

server.py still exposes ADMIN_ACCESS_CODE env var and Optional admin_code field on LoginRequest even though it is no longer enforced. Consider removing the leftover env var and Pydantic field to reduce confusion.
Frontend Auth.js still keeps `admin_code: ''` in its login form state object (line 33). Not rendered, but dead state; safe to remove.
server.py ~1133 lines — still a candidate for splitting into routers (auth/contracts/interviews/exports/admin).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login is now 2-step: (1) POST /api/auth/login {email,password,captcha_id,captcha_answer} (admin_code no longer needed — accepted but ignored); (2) POST /api/auth/verify-otp {email,code}. Codes are in backend.err.log. Test file /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py has full_login() helper. Run pytest with `-n 0` (serial) to avoid OTP contention between xdist workers (the OTP endpoint only keeps the latest pending OTP per email, so parallel logins for the same account race). Frontend Video call modal has data-testid='video-call-modal' with a meet.jit.si iframe; verify only the modal + iframe src (do not exercise real media). Note: admin Messages tab has no conversations by default; skip admin-video-call test if no [data-testid^='conv-'] rows exist.
rca of the issue: ChatWidget.js and AdminDashboard.js used <Video/>, <Phone/> icons and <VideoCall/> component in JSX without importing them (nor was `call`/`setCall` state defined in the Interviews component of AdminDashboard.js). React renders threw `ReferenceError: Video is not defined` the moment the ChatWidget mounted, and Interviews would have thrown when clicking the sidebar. Fix = add the missing imports and useState hook. Verified by re-running Playwright: all flows including candidate ChatWidget calls, admin Interviews list + Rejoindre modal, and admin Messages call buttons now work.
